about.title: About Moss Landscaping
text: Since 1986, Moss Landscaping has helped homeowners, builders, architects, and designers create exceptional outdoor environments throughout Houston. Over the years, our company has grown, but one thing has remained constant: our belief that lasting relationships and outstanding results are built by great people.

Our team brings together experienced designers, project managers, landscape consultants, maintenance professionals, irrigation and drainage specialists, and administrative staff who share a commitment to craftsmanship, communication, and client service. From the first conversation through long-term maintenance, we work collaboratively to ensure every project reflects the vision, quality, and attention to detail that define Moss Landscaping.

Many of our team members have spent years building their careers at Moss, developing deep expertise in Houston’s unique climate, soils, permitting requirements, and landscape challenges. Their knowledge, professionalism, and dedication are what allow us to deliver a seamless experience across design, construction, and maintenance services.
